title: Computation of a separatrix map and a normally hyperbolic invariant lamination for the RP3BP
summary: In this paper we discuss the existence of a normally hyperbolic invariant lamination (NHIL) at the Kirkwood gap $3:1$ for the Restricted Planar Elliptic 3 Body Problem. This problem models the Sun-Jupiter-Asteroid dynamics.
